description: Package berylx .crate archive from clean commit and verify unpacked path-dependency compilation and public workflow API execution in an isolated directory
build: set -eu; unset CARGO_TARGET_DIR; export PATH="$PATH${HOME:+:$HOME/.cargo/bin}"; if [ -n "${CC_INSPECT_INPUT_ARTIFACT:-}" ]; then test -f "$CC_INSPECT_INPUT_ARTIFACT"; exit 0; fi; cargo package --offline --allow-dirty --no-verify --target-dir "$TMPDIR/cargo-package-target"; set -- "$TMPDIR/cargo-package-target/package"/berylx-*.crate; test "$#" -eq 1 && test -f "$1"; cp "$1" "$CC_INSPECT_ARTIFACT_DIR/"
smoke: set -eu; test ! -e .cc-inspect.json && test ! -e Cargo.toml; if [ -n "${CC_INSPECT_INPUT_ARTIFACT:-}" ]; then crate_archive="$CC_INSPECT_INPUT_ARTIFACT"; else set -- "$CC_INSPECT_ARTIFACT_DIR"/berylx-*.crate; test "$#" -eq 1; crate_archive="$1"; fi; test -f "$crate_archive"; mkdir -p unpacked; tar -xzf "$crate_archive" -C unpacked; set -- unpacked/berylx-*; test "$#" -eq 1 && test -f "$1/Cargo.toml" && test -f "$1/src/lib.rs"
